text:
carol_support: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting spikes of 502/504s for hosted inference in eu-west2-a since ~08:45 UTC. One customer pasted curl output: 

carol_support: ```
curl -s -D - "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' -d '{"input":"hi"}'
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Server: nginx
...
```

carol_support: Errors correlate with higher tail latency and auth retries in the gateway logs. Filing here so net/ops can triage. :rotating_light:

ben_neteng: Looking at host egress interfaces now. We're seeing bursts of packet loss to provider AS64513 from eu-west2-az3 egress. If we traceroute to one of the affected upstreams we see intermittent hops dropping.

ben_neteng: ```
$ mtr -r -c 20 203.0.113.45
Start: 2024-05-10T08:47:01+0000
HOST: rtr-eu-west2-az3  Loss%   Snt   Last   Avg  Best  Wrst StDev
 1.|-- 10.0.0.1    0.0%    20    0.3   0.4   0.2   1.2   0.2
 2.|-- 198.51.100.1  0.0%    20    1.2   1.5   1.1   6.3   1.1
 3.|-- 203.0.113.1  12.5%    20   10.1  12.3   9.8  56.2   8.9
 4.|-- 203.0.113.45  7.5%    20   14.2  15.1  14.0  44.0   6.0
```

ben_neteng: BGP adjacencies look flapping toward the transit peer for a few minutes each interval. Suspect provider-side microbursts / queue drops rather than our internal fabric.

dave_oncall: Rolling temporary egress failover for affected prefixes to alternate transit (AS64514) and enabling shorter keepalive on the BGP session to avoid stuck routes. Applying now (will post confirmation).

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Applied route policy `egress-failover-eu-west2-az3` at 1715123570. :white_check_mark:

emma_sre: After the failover we see a drop in 502 rate from 6% -> 1.2% in the last 5m on the gateway metric. Latency p95 improved but some auth retries still spike (likely client-side retries exposing partial failures).

carol_support: Customer replied: degradation improved after ~08:50 but still sees occasional timeouts on longer requests. They asked for ETA and if any credits will be applied.

ben_neteng: Opening a ticket with the transit provider (ref TICKET-9342) and attaching traceroute, BGP RIB samples, and tcpdump around 08:44-08:50. Please capture a pcap from rtr-eu-west2-az3 egress on eth2 for the window.

ben_neteng: ```
sudo tcpdump -w /var/tmp/ew2-az3-egress-1715123400.pcap -c 2000 -i eth2 host 203.0.113.45 and port 179
```

dave_oncall: Collected pcap and pushed to /shares/incidents/1715123456/ — attaching when I finish sanitizing. Also I'll add a temporary routing-rule to prefer local peering where available (to reduce BGP hop count).

carol_support: CS: please hold off on credit promises. I'll update customer: mitigation in place, provider ticket opened, ETA TBD, we'll follow up with postmortem and timeline.

emma_sre: Quick mitigation checklist completed:
- failover egress to AS64514 ✅
- shorten BGP keepalive ✅
- enable cache warm fallback to standby model variant for heavy calls ✅
- extended logs captured for 08:40-09:10 UTC ✅

carol_support: Noted. Customer wants reproduction steps — they run long streaming requests that are sensitive to tail latency. We asked them to switch to the dedicated endpoint as a temporary work-around; they requested instructions.

dave_oncall: Added runbook snippet for support: ```
# Temporary customer workaround
1) Switch -> dedicated-hosted: https://console.redwood.ai/dedicated/{customer_id}
2) Reduce chunk size / increase keepalive on client
3) Retries: backoff jitter 200ms -> 2s
```

customer_alert_bot: AUTO: Alert for hosted-inference-eu-west2-a resolved (partial) at 1715123660 — any remaining errors are being tracked as ongoing low-rate errors.

ben_neteng: Provider responded: 'we observed interface microbursts leading to transient drops, fixing queue config now and monitoring.' They claim the fix started rolling at 08:55 UTC. We'll keep the failover for 30m to ensure stability then revert.

emma_sre: OK to start revert test at 1715123900 if metrics stay stable for 15m. I'll coordinate canary traffic and rollback plan.

carol_support: I'll update the status page: note degraded service in eu-west2 affecting some customers, mitigation applied, provider ticket opened. Will follow up with postmortem and customer outreach. :memo:

dave_oncall: Postmortem action items:
- capture full RIB and BGP logs for 08:30–09:15 UTC (ben)
- pcap analysis and attach to provider ticket (dave)
- write RCA and follow-up on credits policy with CS (carol + finance)
- consider automated failover playbook for transit microbursts (emma)

carol_support: Thanks — looping in billing/finance for potential credit discussion. Marking this thread for incident PM. :thumbsup:

emma_sre: Quick note: OBSERVABILITY -> set an alert for >3% packet loss on any egress hop for 2m to avoid slow escalations next time.

ben_neteng: Agreed. Also adding synthetic pings to the provider peering IPs every 30s.

carol_support: Closing interim triage. Will reopen if customer reports new issues. Thanks all.
